verdict.rationale: The probe record describes the edd.ca.gov guidance pages as open. Page text was extracted from several guidance URLs with a standard pipeline UA, so the main public reading surface was reachable without a key. However, the transactional host eddservices.edd.ca.gov returned HTTP 403 even at robots.txt, and no probe explicitly checks for CAPTCHA, JS-only rendering, or bot-wall behavior on the guidance pages. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming no bot wall, CAPTCHA, or JS-only shell on the guidance pages; independent hands-on corroboration; and keyless reachability of the eddservices.edd.ca.gov host (403 observed).

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
